name: harness-lens-vscode-workspace
description: VS Code integration workspace for HarnessLens.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @harness-lens/vscode && npm run build --workspace packages/extension
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace @harness-lens/vscode && npm run build --workspace @harness-lens/vscode && npm run check --workspace packages/extension && npm run version:check
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run pack:npm && npm run package:extension
scripts.package:extension: npm run artifacts && npm run package --workspace packages/extension
scripts.pack:npm: npm run artifacts && npm pack --workspace @harness-lens/vscode --pack-destination artifacts
